_comment: CA004 - Block sign-in from unapproved locations. Applies to: the Halden Microsoft Entra ID tenant (P2, lab only). Every location except 'AllTrusted' is treated as unapproved, so sign-ins from anywhere that has not been explicitly trusted are blocked. The trusted named location is created and named in the tenant before this policy is enforced; in the lab the trusted entry is optional and the policy is reviewed in report-only first. Deployed by 07-New-ConditionalAccessPolicies.ps1.
displayName: CA004 - Block sign-in from unapproved countries
